t: What he compared himself and everyone else to
a: فَأَنَا آخُذُ بِحُجَزِكُمْ عَنِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَقْتَحِمُونَ فِيهَا
p: Fa-anā ākhudhu bi-ḥujazikum ʿani-n-nār, wa antum taqtaḥimūna fīhā
m: So I am taking hold of your waistbands, holding you back from the Fire, and you are plunging into it.
